recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs inside bubblewrap with a read-only host root, one fresh writable /tmp directory, --unshare-net, --clearenv, fixed locale/timezone/thread count, --trust=0, and an explicit pinned LEAN_PATH. The canonical compiled dependency closure is reused read-only and warm, so this is nonrelease narrow replay rather than the section 10.6 cold build.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line gate summary naming the passed narrow checks and the fail-closed root, complete-trust, cold-hermetic, and distinct-verifier gates

recipes.scope_boundary: The root declaration is elaborated as a statement and the final composer is checked only conditionally. The three proof declarations cover exact marginals and the constant-law boundary, not an unconditional Skorokhod coupling. Proof/root closure, accepted foundation and complete trust/provenance, cold offline reproduction, and distinct independent verification are evaluated fail closed.
